value.expression: First 20 year-end observations: initial start-year Dec31 through start-year+19 Dec31; inclusive term endpoints; no 1999 follow-up truncation

basis.rationale: Independent interpretation; see independent-plan.md. No Gold used.

value.description: Fixed cohort denominator = count distinct people whose global first term starts in 1917..1999. For period 0..19, observation is Dec31 in start year plus period; numerator people with any inclusive term covering observation; retain all periods including zero. Ratio 0..1.

candidates.sql: WITH RECURSIVE periods(period) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT period+1 FROM periods WHERE period<19), first AS (SELECT id_bioguide,min(term_start) first_start FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide), cohort AS (SELECT * FROM first WHERE first_start BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'), observations AS (SELECT c.*,p.period,printf('%04d-12-31',cast(substr(c.first_start,1,4) as int)+p.period) snapshot FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN periods p), counts AS (SELECT period,count(*) cohort_size,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=o.id_bioguide AND o.snapshot BETWEEN t.term_start AND t.term_end)) retained FROM observations o GROUP BY period) SELECT period,retained*1.0/cohort_size AS retention_rate FROM counts ORDER BY period
